text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-, six-, nine-, and 12-month treasury bills yields slipped from the last sale on February 25, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Three-month bills edged down to 26.83 percent from 27.88 percent, six-month bills slipped to 32.65 percent from 32.89 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 35.09 percent from 35.56 percent, and 12-month bills also slipped to 38.21 percent from 38.48 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill
auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 7.50 million UAH 25.00 million UAH
Amount sold 7.29 million UAH 25.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.83 million UAH 23.37 million UAH
The central bank sold 72,895 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 37,265 were competitive and 35,630 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 4.
The results of Thursday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15.00 million UAH 35.00 million UAH
Amount sold 13.86 million UAH 34.35 million UAH
Actual amount raised 11.92 million UAH 29.51 million UAH
The central bank sold 138,629 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 57,869 were competitive and 80,760 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 4.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 30.00 million UAH 45.00 million UAH
Amount sold 30.00 million UAH 43.73 million UAH
Actual amount raised 23.76 million UAH 34.55 million UAH
The central bank sold 300,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 203,090 were competitive and 96,910 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 4.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 40.00 million UAH 55.00 million UAH
Amount sold 38.63 million UAH 53.11 million UAH
Actual amount raised 27.97 million UAH 38.38 million UAH
The central bank sold 386,337 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 247,917 were competitive and 138,420 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 4.
